bear_assumptions: USD20.19 normalized EPS at 14x; price-cost pressure, construction weakness, leverage and poor cash conversion persist despite re-roofing demand.
base_assumptions: USD20.19 normalized EPS at 18x; re-roofing resilience and second-half pricing recovery preserve normalized earnings without a cyclical acceleration.
bull_assumptions: USD20.19 normalized EPS at 22x; pricing catches up, segment margins recover, cash conversion normalizes and disciplined repurchases lift per-share value.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger normalized earnings and cash conversion clear every expected, base, payoff and margin-of-safety gate after a specific relationship is accepted; downgrade if price-cost pressure, re-roofing demand, cash conversion, leverage or capital allocation deteriorates.
